mapper.insert: INSERT INTO body_cam (bc_image_path, bc_type, bc_ai_result, user_num) VALUES (#{bcImagePath}, #{bcType}, #{bcAiResult}, #{userNum})
mapper.select: SELECT bc_num AS bcNum, bc_image_path AS bcImagePath, bc_type AS bcType, bc_ai_result AS bcAiResult, user_num AS userNum, DATE_FORMAT(bc_date, '%Y.%m.%d') AS bcDate FROM body_cam WHERE user_num = #{userNum} ORDER BY bc_num DESC
